item.title: Re: @fterlife.net (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Sorry writer, but you need a specific layout for the Ideas Critique Forum in order for it to be accepted.

Seeking Greenlights: Put yes or no.

Page Type: SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify)

Genre (Optional): Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify)

Page Layout (Optional): How will you structure the page in terms of information presentation, or plot development? If you plan on using a unique format/format screw, describe that here.

Elevator Pitch: What is the basic core idea? Use a bullet point list if necessary.

Central Narrative: Describe the story beats or overarching context/"big picture" for your piece. If there is no story content, put "none". (Note that it is extremely rare for articles without narrative context or worldbuilding content to receive greenlights.)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: What is novel/unique about your premise? What is special about your idea here that will make it stand out among the other works already on the mainsite?

Additional Notes: Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.

item.title: @fterlife.net (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking greenlights: Yes
Page type: SCP article
Page layout: standard layout
Object class: Eculid
Containment proceduce: Any attempt to access SCP XXXX online must be redirected. The main focus of containment is to conceal the existence of this database from other group of interests. Testing required level 2 or higher.
Description: An online database. When an X digits number is inputted, it might allows the user to enter a page with documents about a deceased person and an AI resembling that person. At the moment, the foundation has only gained access to a small amount of pages. Others are locked and require "Administrator's permission".
Addeum: Through some of the accessable page, the foundation manage to explore the afterlife (resembling fhe afterlife in Divine Comedy but some element are more related to technology and simulation).
Hook: The main idea of this article is that since we spend so much time on the internet, it is slowingly become similar to a religion. Furthermore, I believe the exploration logs will be really interesting as messing around in hell using codes are as fun as it sound. I also want to link this to Mekhane, perhaps by using the internet so much, we sunconciously repair a part of his heart: his dream.
